dress_code.women: Modest and traditional Indian attire is recommended. While there is no mandatory uniform, avoid short outfits.

general_rules: Photography & Videography: Strictly Prohibited anywhere inside the temple premises.
Electronic Gadgets: Mobile phones, cameras and electronic devices are generally not permitted inside.. Free security cloakroom / lockers are available at the entrance.
Footwear Rule: Footwear must be deposited at the free footwear counter at the base of the hill before climbing the marble stairs.
Dress Code: Modest and traditional Indian attire is recommended.
dos: Deposit Your Phone Early: Advise readers to surrender all phones and smartwatches at the main security cloakroom booth to prevent getting turned back at the inner metal detectors.
Enjoy the Panoramic View: Take time to sit on the marble benches on the upper deck to capture the spectacular breeze and views of the city skyline.
donts: No Photography At All: Photography and videography are strictly prohibited everywhere inside the gated hill complex, not just inside the inner room. Violators risk immediate device confiscation by security guards.
Do Not Wear Western Shorts: While there is no mandatory uniform, avoid short outfits. Dress modestly to comply with local religious sentiments.
